scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty packages/core packages/parser-react packages/router-next packages/cli && tsc -p packages/viewer/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run demo:run && npm run demo:view

scripts.dev:viewer: npm run demo:run && node scripts/viewer-fixture.mjs && npm -w @jsxray/viewer run dev
